name: web-arabic-educational-platform-responsive-case-study-cover
title: Arabic educational platform UI/UX case study cover on laptop, tablet and phone
whatItIs: A light cover with a 'UI/UX Case Study' label and a mortarboard logo, showing an Arabic right-to-left learning site on a laptop, tablet and phone: a classroom hero photo with dark green overlay, green CTAs and course cards.
whatItMeans: Credible and accessible; three devices prove the RTL layout works everywhere.
techniques: Show the same page on three devices.
Use a photo hero with a brand-colour overlay.
Label the cover as a case study in the corner.

vocabulary.definition: Right-to-left layout used for Arabic and Hebrew.
A design that adapts to different screen sizes.
